lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a structured grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, vertical linear indentation is visible on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the fifth gill slit, distinct from the primary gill architecture.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense and uniform distribution of small, high-luminance spots across its entire visible dorsal surface.
